text:
alex: throwing another shape at continuous-batching: 'reinsertion via credits' - tiny fastpath requests skip the coalesce window but can be reinjected into the next batch to reuse warmed KV. main tradeoff is risking head-of-line latency for long requests.

mira: high level makes sense. reinjection mid-batch = bad. can we constrain reinserts to only occur at batch cut points to avoid delaying inflight long requests?

sam: yep. implement a per-tenant reinsertion queue that only flushes at batch boundaries. cheap and local. downside: the next batch can balloon if many tenants reinject concurrently.

tj: cheap admission rule: each reinject carries merge_cost_est (tokens). tenant has a credit bucket that refills at credit_rate. accept reinject only if credit_balance >= merge_cost_est. prevents noisy tenants from spiking next batch.

chen: add a headroom guard: if batch remaining headroom < headroom_threshold_ms then reject reinserts. this keeps p99 tail under control during peaks.

caroline: consider KV affinity: fastpath emits kv_fingerprint for warmed prefix. reinserts prefer batches matching that fingerprint to avoid cross-affinity pollution. make affinity optional behind a flag.

alex: exposing affinity in batch key is a surface change. moderate refactor but incremental if we default affinity off. need per-affinity caps so buckets don't starve.

mira: observability req: metrics merge_reinject_attempts, accept_rate, tokens_used, added_tokens_per_batch, p99_delta.post_reinject. alert if p99_delta > 5% sustained 5m.

infra-bot: perf-canary launched: cluster "reinjection-proto" (4xA100), owner @caroline. logs: https://internal.redwood/infra/reinjection-proto

caroline: ran a 8h sim overnight. reinjection cut cold-KV misses ~32% for small fastpath requests, but under high contention p99 increased ~7ms. throughput stable.

alex: good signal. plan options: conservative reinjection (credits + headroom + optional affinity) vs aggressive (always join). conservative first.

tj: implementation plan: POC hook in batcher that reads tenant credit, checks headroom, appends microqueue on accept. config knobs: reinject_enabled, credit_rate, headroom_threshold_ms, affinity_enabled, max_reinject_items_per_tenant.

mira: I'll own metrics/dashboarding and an event stream when reinjects are rejected for SLO reasons so support can debug.

chen: tag tokens from reinjection with telemetry 'merge_origin=reinjection' so Optimize can tie cost/latency changes to reinjection.

alex: cancellation semantics: if client cancels while queued in reinjection queue, remove and refund credits. avoid leaving holes.

sam: agree. only charge credits on actual execution. queue removal on cancel to keep packing clean.

caroline: safety: bound per-tenant reinject queue (e.g., max_reinject_items_per_tenant=40) and global reinject buffer to avoid DOS memory amplification.

alex: timeline? need a low-fidelity prototype + perf run within ~10 days to decide. who can spike?

tj: I'll spike. will PR credit-model doc + POC batcher hook by EOW.

mira: I'll add dashboard tiles: reinject_accept_rate, p99_delta, per-tenant_credit_balance histogram.

chen: I'll write a small sim for affinity collisions to measure cross-affinity pollution risk.

alex: sweet. we'll review canary results before any rollout. tagging this as follow-up for continuous-batching refactor RFC. :thumbsup:
